name: comp-365
blurb: Thumbnail link that opens a hovercard showing article title, description, and metadata.
description: Image link that triggers a hover card displaying article title, summary text, read time, and last update date. Includes an arrow pointer.
use_when: Article/content preview cards in feeds, related articles, or recommendations.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces; requires hover to activate.
a11y: Image link is keyboard-focusable; hovercard appears on hover only.
